title: receipt with future date is rejected for all users
description: Login as admin (username=jose, password=Password1). POST /api/transactions/receipts with transactionDate set to tomorrow's date (future). Expect 400 response with error message 'Transaction date cannot be in the future'. Then login as standard user (username=alix, password=Password1) and repeat — also expect 400 with same message.

title: receipt with date older than 30 days is rejected for all users
description: Login as admin (username=jose, password=Password1). POST /api/transactions/receipts with transactionDate set to 35 days ago. Expect 400 response with error containing 'cannot be more than 30 days in the past'. Then login as standard user (username=alix, password=Password1) and repeat — also expect 400.

title: standard user blocked from posting receipt older than 7 days
description: Login as standard user (username=alix, password=Password1). POST /api/transactions/receipts with transactionDate set to 10 days ago, itemId for an existing item (use GET /api/items to find one), location='ADEL', quantity=1, unitCost=10. Expect 400 response with error containing 'must be posted by an admin'.

title: admin can post receipt between 8-30 days in the past
description: Login as admin (username=jose, password=Password1). POST /api/transactions/receipts with transactionDate set to 10 days ago, a valid itemId (use GET /api/items to find one), location='ADEL', quantity=1, unitCost=10. Expect 201 success response with the created transaction.

title: standard user can post receipt within 7 days
description: Login as standard user (username=alix, password=Password1). POST /api/transactions/receipts with transactionDate set to 3 days ago, a valid itemId (use GET /api/items to find one), location='ADEL', quantity=1, unitCost=5. Expect 201 success response with the created transaction.

title: standard user can read BOMs list
description: Login as standard user (username=alix, password=Password1). GET /api/boms with the auth token. Expect 200 response with an array of BOM objects. This verifies that BOM read access is no longer restricted to admin only.

title: standard user can read single BOM by id
description: Login as standard user (username=alix, password=Password1). First GET /api/boms to get the list and pick the first BOM id. Then GET /api/boms/:id with that id. Expect 200 response with BOM object including components array. This verifies single BOM read access works for non-admin.

title: standard user cannot create or modify BOMs
description: Login as standard user (username=alix, password=Password1). POST /api/boms with body {name:'Test BOM', code:'TEST-BOM', finishedGoodId:1, components:[{itemId:1, quantityPer:1}]}. Expect 403 Forbidden. This verifies write operations on BOMs still require admin.
